# opnsense_unbound_service (Resource)

Manages only the persistent Unbound service enable flag. The resource uses read/modify/write and preserves every other Unbound setting. Do not manage `general.enabled` through `opnsense_unbound_settings` at the same time.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_unbound_service" "resolver" {
  # BIND owns TCP/UDP 53 in this deployment.
  enabled = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Unbound is persistently enabled.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `unbound_service`.
